metadata.title: Generating the liftable outer automorphism groups of regular cyclic covers
metadata.abstract: Let $R_n = \bigvee_{i=1}^{n} S^1$ be a finite connected one-dimensional CW complex with $n \geq 2$, and let $\mathrm{Out}(F_n)$ be the outer automorphism group of the free group $F_n$, where $\pi_1(R_n)\cong F_n$. Let $p_k:\tilde{R}_n\rightarrow R_n$ be the standard $k$-sheeted regular cyclic cover of $R_n$ induced by a $\mathbb{Z}_k$-action on $\tilde{R}_n$ (which is homotopy equivalent to $R_{n_k}$, where $n_k=k(n-1)+1$) generated by a free rotation through $2\pi/k$ of $\tilde{R}_n$. Let $\mathrm{Out}_{F_{n_k}}(F_n)$ be the liftable outer automorphism group associated with a standard $k$-sheeted normal cover $p_k$. For $n\geq3$, we show that $\{\mathrm{Out}_{F_{n_k}}(F_n)\}_{k\geq2}$ forms an infinite family of self-normalizing subgroups of $\mathrm{Out}(F_n)$. For $n\geq2$, these groups are maximal if and only if $k$ is prime. Furthermore, we derive explicit finite generating sets for $\mathrm{Out}_{F_{n_k}}(F_n)$ for $k\geq 2$ and $n\geq 3$. Let $\mathcal{C}$ be the infinite chain of roses, and let $q_n:\mathcal{C}\longrightarrow R_n$ be the standard infinite-sheeted cover induced by $\langle \tau\rangle$, where $\tau$ is the unit translation on $\mathcal{C}$. As a final application, we obtain a finite generating set for $\mathrm{Out}_{F_\infty}(F_n)$ when $n\geq 3$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 提升子群的生成与极大性
analysis.workSummary: 对n圈玫瑰图R_n的标准k层正则循环覆盖，覆盖秩n_k=k(n−1)+1，研究可提升外自同构子群。n≥3时这些k≥2的子群构成Out(F_n)的无限自正规化族；n≥2时极大当且仅当k为素数。对n≥3、k≥2给出显式有限生成集，并对无限玫瑰链的标准无限层覆盖得到可提升外自同构群的有限生成集。
techniques: 标准循环覆盖与提升判据
analysis.breakthrough: 同时刻画标准循环覆盖的可提升子群的正规化、极大性和有限生成性。
analysis.limitations: 各结论的n范围不同：自正规化与生成集需n≥3，极大性允许n=2；不涵盖任意覆盖或任意正规子群。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
